models_evaluated: Deep learning CAD foreign object detection software for retained surgical sponges

links.outcome: Specificity of CAD in clinical setting versus development-phase performance
links.effect: CAD flagged possible retained items in 150 of 1,053 images; specificity 85.8%, similar to development-phase data, so real-world performance matched development performance.
links.quote: Specificity was 85.8%, which is similar to the data obtained during the development of the software.

screen.reason: Prospective validation of deep-learning CAD software deployed directly onto a portable radiographic device in the operating room to detect retained surgical sponges.
